title: Google+ Sign-In
description: Allows users/agents to log in using Google accounts.

settings_def.name: client_id
settings_def.label: Client ID
settings_def.description: You can find or create this in your Google developer console (https://console.developers.google.com/). Once there, follow: APIs & Auth -> Credentials -> OAuth.

settings_def.name: client_secret
settings_def.label: Client Secret
settings_def.description: You can find or create this in your Google developer console (https://console.developers.google.com/). Once there, follow: APIs & Auth -> Credentials -> OAuth.

settings_def.name: google_apps_domain
settings_def.label: Google Apps Domain
settings_def.description: Optionally enter your Google Apps domain (e.g. example.com - no www. or http://) to allow only users from within your organisation to log in. When enabled, normal Google users (e.g. example@gmail.com) will not be allowed.

settings_def.name: auto_agent
settings_def.label: Auto Agent
settings_def.checkbox_label: Automatically create agents if they do not already exist

inline_dependant.name: auto_agent_permission_group
inline_dependant.label: Add new agents to this permission group

settings_def.name: auto_user_permission_group
settings_def.label: Grant Usergroup
settings_def.description: Add this usergroup to users who login with this usersource

settings_def.name: raw_info_filter
settings_def.label: Filter
settings_def.description: You can filter based on info provided by the usersource. Learn about this feature
